name: Plenoxels Optimization Configuration
definition: Optimizes voxel opacity ($\sigma$) and spherical harmonic (SH) coefficients using gradient-based optimizers with specific learning rate schedules.
summary: Plenoxels Optimization Configuration defines hyperparameters for training sparse voxel grids without neural networks, distinguished by its focus on numerical stability for spherical harmonic coefficients using RMSProp.
